title: GitHub Incident with Git Operations, Pull Requests and Actions
title_zh: GitHub 事件：Git 操作、拉取请求与动作

paragraphs.en: We'll send you email if your endpoint fails
paragraphs.zh: 如果您的端点出现故障，我们将向您发送电子邮件。

paragraphs.en: Get tips, technical guides, and best practices. Twice a month. Right in your inbox.
paragraphs.zh:
获取提示、技术指南和最佳实践。每两期一次，直接送达您的收件箱。

等等，"Twice a month" 应译为「每月两次」。

获取提示、技术指南和最佳实践。每月两次，直接送达您的收件箱。

paragraphs.en: Subscribe to updates for Incident with Git Operations, Pull Requests and Actions via email and/or text message. You'll receive email notifications when incidents are updated, and text message notifications whenever GitHub creates or resolves an incident.
paragraphs.zh: 通过电子邮件和/或短信订阅 Git 操作、拉取请求和 Actions 事件的更新。 当事件更新时，您将收到电子邮件通知；每当 GitHub 创建或解决事件时，您将收到短信通知。
